pr.title: Privacy policy — Activala®
pr.meta: Activala's privacy policy: what details we collect when you contact us, what for, and how to exercise your rights.
pr.resp.p: Activala®, a brand operated by Óscar Belloso Jiménez, tax ID (NIF) 46922078P, reachable on the WhatsApp shown on this website. We are the ones who decide what the details you give us are used for, and the ones who answer for them.
pr.datos.h: What details we collect and what for
pr.datos.p1: Only what you type into the form or send us on WhatsApp:
pr.datos.li1: If you own a home: your name, language, email, WhatsApp and where the home is. We use them to assess your home and contact you with a proposal.
pr.datos.li2: If you're looking for a home: your name, language, email, WhatsApp and the months you'd like to come. We use them to send you available homes that fit.
pr.datos.p2: We don't ask for ID numbers or bank details on this website. We don't use your details for third-party advertising, and we don't sell them to anyone.
pr.base.p: Your consent, which you give us by ticking the box before sending the form, and the pre-contractual steps you ask us for when you request that we look at your case (art. 6.1.a and 6.1.b of the GDPR).
pr.plazo.p: While we handle your request and, at most, one year from the last contact if we don't end up working together. If you become a client, the periods become those of the contract and those required by tax law.
pr.comp.p: With our technical providers, who act as data processors under contract: Supabase (database) and Resend (sending email notices). There are no other recipients.
pr.der.p: You can ask us for access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability of your details whenever you like, on WhatsApp or by email. We reply and delete whatever you ask, no questions asked. If you think we've got something wrong, you can complain to the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (the Spanish data protection authority, aepd.es).
pr.aviso: This website uses no tracking cookies and no third-party analytics. We only keep our own anonymous count of visits (a random identifier stored in your browser, with no name, email or IP), which tells us how many people visit and from which country. It's all explained in detail on the cookies page.
al.title: Legal notice — Activala®
al.meta: Activala's legal notice: who is behind this website, what the service is, and terms of use.
al.quien.p1: This website is owned by Óscar Belloso Jiménez, tax ID (NIF) 46922078P, who operates under the Activala® brand. You can get in touch on the WhatsApp shown on this website, which is our usual way of helping you.
al.quien.p2: Activala® is part of Grupo Saneas, alongside the other brands shown in the footer of this website. Each one answers for its own business.
al.que.h: What this service is and what it is not
al.que.p1: Activala manages the rental of homes in the south of Gran Canaria on behalf of their owners: it gets the home ready, maintains it, finds a tenant, handles the paperwork and keeps the owner informed of how things are going. To the tenant, it lets those same homes by the week or by the month, at a fixed total price and with no agency fee.
al.que.aviso: This is not a financial product or a promise of returns. What a home ends up earning depends on the home, the season and demand. On this website we don't promise figures: when we talk numbers, it's about your specific case and in writing.
al.que.p2: Nor are we your tax advisor. When we explain that renting out legally pays off, we do so in general terms; the person who has to do your sums is your advisor, with your figures in front of them.
al.cond.li1: Using this website is free and commits you to nothing. Filling in a form is asking for information, not signing.
al.cond.li2: Whatever is signed later — the owner's engagement or the tenant's rental — is governed by its own contract, with its own prices and terms. That contract prevails, not this website.
al.cond.li3: You undertake to give us truthful information. Both the assessment of a home and the search for a tenant are built on what you tell us.
al.cond.li4: You may not use this website for anything unlawful or anything that harms how it works.
al.precios.p: The amounts shown on this website are indicative and may change. The price that counts is the one in your proposal or in your contract, and there you will always see whether taxes are included.
al.pi.p1: The texts, images, design and the Activala® brand are ours or used with permission. You may read them and share links, but not copy or reuse them without authorisation.
al.pi.p2: The videos and photographs of people illustrating this website are stock material: they are examples, not real clients, and the names alongside them are made up. Any third-party brands that appear belong to their owners and are not affiliated with Activala.
al.resp.p1: We take care to keep everything here accurate and up to date, but we can't promise the website will always run without interruptions or that there are no mistakes. If you find one, tell us and we'll fix it.
al.resp.p2: Nor do we answer for the content of third-party websites we link to.
al.idiomas.p: This website, including these legal pages, can be read in five languages. The translations are provided to make reading easier: if a translation and the Spanish text don't say exactly the same thing, the Spanish version prevails.
al.ley.p: These terms are governed by Spanish law. For any dispute, jurisdiction lies with the courts that apply under consumer law.
al.datos.p: It's all explained in the privacy policy, and what we store in your browser, on the cookies page.
ck.title: Cookies and storage — Activala®
ck.meta: What Activala stores in your browser: the language you choose and a random identifier to count visits. No advertising and no third-party tracking.
ck.aviso.p1: This website doesn't set a single cookie. There's no advertising, no Facebook pixel, no Google Analytics, nothing that follows you around other websites. That's also why you don't get that cookie-consent banner here: there would be nothing to accept.
ck.aviso.p2: The only things we leave in your browser are two notes of our own, kept in local storage. They don't travel anywhere except as we explain just below.
ck.t.r1c2: To remember whether you chose Spanish, German, English, Norwegian or Swedish, so we don't ask you again
ck.t.r1c3: Until you clear the site's data
ck.t.r2c2: To count distinct visitors without knowing who you are
ck.t.r2c3: Until you clear the site's data
ck.no.li1: Your IP is not stored. The server works out the country from the connection and discards the address.
ck.no.li2: No name, no email, nothing that identifies you, unless you write it to us in the form or on WhatsApp. That's explained in the privacy policy.
ck.no.li3: No third-party cookies for advertising purposes.
ck.no.li4: Not even the fonts come from outside. This website's fonts are served from activala.es, so loading it doesn't report your visit to anyone.
ck.id.p1: It's a random number created the first time you visit, and it lives only in your browser. Once a day it travels along with the type of device (iPhone, Android or other), whether you're using the website installed as an app, and the country the server works out. That tells us whether the website is any use; the count is not public and can only be seen from Grupo Saneas's private panel.
ck.id.p2: We rely on the legitimate interest of knowing whether the website works (art. 6.1.f of the GDPR), with data that cannot identify you. If you browse in a private window, nothing is stored and we don't push it.
ck.borrar.p1: From your browser, at any time and without asking our permission:
ck.borrar.li1: Chrome / Android: Settings → Privacy and security → Clear browsing data.
ck.borrar.li2: Safari / iPhone: Settings → Safari → Clear History and Website Data.
ck.borrar.li3: Or use a private window: when you close it, nothing is left.
ck.borrar.p2: If you delete it, the website keeps working just the same. It will only ask you your language again, and we'll stop counting you as a repeat visit.
ck.mas.p: What we do with the details you do give us is in the privacy policy. Who is behind this website, in the legal notice.
